We have to make life more affordable. I’m a finance guy who actually built a career in the private sector — I understand how the economics come together.

Other folks talk a big game, then they need a lobbyist or staffer to explain policy to them. 

Not me.

I am extremely proud to earn the endorsement of the Florida Farm Bureau.

From citrus groves to cattle ranches to the row crops stretching across our Heartland, farmers and ranchers are the backbone of the Florida Dream.

As Governor, I will work tirelessly to ensure that Florida’s farmers and agricultural community stay strong for generations to come.

posts.text:
Spent some time at Lake Okeechobee this morning.

There is no place in the world like Florida, and I intend to keep it that way.

This lake supports 8 million Floridians, sustains the Everglades, and anchors agriculture and rural communities across South Florida. I've spent years bringing together farmers, conservationists, and water managers to find real solutions. As Governor, that work continues.
